children: Shares of Instacart
are trending higher into Wednesday’s open following a series of pivotal partnerships for the online grocery marketplace and delivery platform.
Over the past 24 hours, Instacart
announced delivery partnerships with
and
and a collaboration with
that brings Gopuff grocery and convenience selection to the Instacart
marketplace. The partnership also extends Instacart’s
advertising technology to Gopuff’s platform.

Under the terms of their agreement, Instacart customers can order groceries and household essentials from Gopuff. Gopuff will then handle fulfillment and order deliveries through its network of its delivery infrastructure, with some deliveries available in less than 15 minutes.
This gives Instacart
the ability to offer faster grocery delivery and 24-hour delivery in certain markets while also offering Gopuff access to Instacart’s
Carrot Ads. Advertisers will be able to run ad campaigns on Gopuff’s digital storefront through the Instacart platform.
Instacart
also announced a partnership with Dollar General
to offer same-day delivery. The partnership will launch with a pilot at approximately 7K Dollar General
and pOpshelf stores in six states over the coming weeks with plans to expand to 20K stores across 48 states this fall.
Instacart
shares are up more than 4% into the open.

title: Instacart shares buoyed by new partnerships with Airbnb, Dollar General, Gopuff
